boundary_review.finding: The only extra common-foreground match is a lorry-frame component per kilogram. Whole-vehicle material intensities must not be applied to it merely to increase coverage; retain the existing component boundary restrictions.

The common foreground contains the configured one-kWe PEM stack per unit. Its existing conversion is 0.001 MW per unit. This is a plausible exact selector extension; native and curated stack identities require separate reference/output checks before changing mappings.

The broad ecoinvent filter also matches two treatment services in the combined metadata census. They are not solid-oxide stack production. Do not copy that filter to UVEK; require exact production/reference identities.
